cancelledHint: Fix the lines below and import the file again: an import is all or nothing.
fixFirst: Fix the invalid rows to import this file
distanceHint: Distance columns without a _km or _mi suffix are read in {unit}.
helpIntro: The first line names the columns, in any order. Required columns are in green, optional ones follow. Upper or lower case, accents, spaces and unit suffixes such as (km) are ignored, and French names (date, cout, kilometrage...) are accepted. Other columns are ignored.
mappingHint: Choose what each column holds, or ignore it. Distance columns come in km or mi.
profileSaveLabel: Save these settings for files with the same columns
undoMessage: The {count} rows it created and that are still in place will be deleted, including any edits made to them since. This cannot be undone.
